title: PLAY THIS EVERY MORNING BEFORE YOU START YOUR DAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: In the mighty name of Jesus, I receive grace to minister to you this morning. The Lord bless you. The Lord keep you. The Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace in the mighty name of Jesus. Beloved, I want you to understand that there is something profoundly spiritual about the morning hour. The Bible says in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord.

In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." There is a principle of first fruits that operates in the realm of the spirit. When you give God the first of your day, you are literally saying, "Lord, everything that concerns this day, I submit it unto you." I need you to understand that prayer is not just a religious activity. Prayer is the medium through which the supernatural invades the natural. Prayer is the vehicle through which heaven's agenda becomes earth's reality.

And when you pray in the morning, you are literally setting the tone. You are establishing the atmosphere. You are creating the environment for divine intervention throughout that day. The scripture says in Mark 1:35, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." If Jesus, the son of God, understood the power of morning prayer, how much more should we, who are dependent on his grace. Jesus didn't pray because he was religious.

Jesus pray because he understood that prayer is the place where divine strategy is downloaded, where heavenly wisdom is received, where the father's will becomes crystal clear. Now, I want to pray with you this morning. And as I pray, I want you to engage your spirit. Don't just be a passive listener. The Bible says in Romans 8:26, "Likewise, the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities.

For we know not what we should pray for as we ought, but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered." So, as I lead you in prayer, I want you to allow the Holy Spirit to take over your spirit, to ignite your prayer life, to set your soul on fire for the things of God. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace this morning. Lord, I thank you for the gift of life. I thank you for the breath in our nostrils.

I thank you that we are not gathered here by accident, but by divine orchestration. Lord, I pray that as we lift our voices in prayer this morning, that the heavens will open, that angels will be dispatched, that every demonic interference will be silenced in the mighty name of Jesus. Lord, I decree that this is not just another morning. This is a morning of divine visitation. This is a morning of supernatural breakthrough.

This is a morning where captives will be set free, where yolks will be destroyed, where burdens will be lifted in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy over every life under the sound of my voice. Whether you are watching from your room, whether you are listening in your car, whether you are in your office, I decree that the anointing of the Holy Ghost will locate you right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I ask that you will give us the spirit of revelation.

Ephesians 1:17 says that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him. Lord, we don't want to pray ignorantly. We don't want to pray religiously. We want to pray with understanding. We want to pray with accuracy. We want to pray with precision. So, Holy Spirit, teach us how to pray. Show us what to pray for. Lead us into the depth of intercession that produces results in the mighty name of Jesus.

Now, beloved, I want you to lift up your voice with me. I want you to begin to thank the Lord for his faithfulness. The Bible says in Lamentations 3:22:3, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. So right now, begin to give him praise. Begin to give him glory. Begin to magnify his holy name. Father, we thank you that your mercies are new every morning. We thank you that your compassions fail not.

We thank you that you have kept us through the night. Lord, we could have died in our sleep, but you preserved us. We could have been attacked by the enemy, but you sent your angels to encamp round about us. We thank you, Lord. We magnify your name. We exalt you. We lift you high in the mighty name of Jesus. Lord, I come against every spirit of slumber this morning. I come against every spirit of laziness. I come against every spirit of spiritual dullness.

I decree that as we pray, fresh fire will fall, fresh oil will be poured, fresh grace will be released in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy that this prayer session will not be ordinary. This prayer session will produce extraordinary results. This prayer session will shift things in the realm of the spirit in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, I want us to engage in prophetic declarations.

The Bible says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." You need to understand that your mouth is a weapon. Your tongue is a tool of creation. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." So when you declare the word of God, you are not just speaking into the air, you are creating reality. You are establishing divine order.

You are enforcing heaven's verdict. I decree over your life this morning that every closed door will open. Isaiah 22:22 says, "And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder. So he shall open and none shall shut and he shall shut and none shall open." I prophesy that divine doors are opening for you now. Doors of favor, doors of opportunity, doors of advancement, doors of promotion, doors of breakthrough in the mighty name of Jesus.

I decree that every barrier that has stood against your progress is broken right now. Every limitation that has held you back is shattered right now. Every obstacle that has blocked your way is removed right now in the mighty name of Jesus. The Bible says in Isaiah 45:2, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron." Father, I ask that you will go before your children today. Make their crooked places straight.

Break in pieces every gate of brass that has stood against them. cut in sunder every bar of iron that has imprisoned their destiny in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy acceleration over your life. What has taken others years to achieve, you will achieve in months. What has taken others months to accomplish, you will accomplish in weeks, the Bible says in Isaiah 60-22, a little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time.

I decree that God is hastening your time. God is accelerating your season. God is fasttracking your destiny in the mighty name of Jesus. Now I want us to pray concerning divine protection. Psalm 91 is not just a beautiful chapter to read. Psalm 91 is a covenant of protection. It is a divine guarantee. It is heaven's insurance policy. The Bible says in Psalm 91:1-2, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty.

I will say of the Lord, he's my refuge and my fortress, my God. In him will I trust." Father, in the name of Jesus, I cover every life under the sound of my voice with the blood of Jesus. I plead the blood of Jesus over your spirit, over your soul, over your body. I plead the blood of Jesus over your family, over your children, over your spouse, over your loved ones. I plead the blood of Jesus over your business, over your career, over your ministry, over your finances in the mighty name of Jesus.

I decree that no weapon fashioned against you shall prosper. Isaiah 54-17 says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, sayeth the Lord. I prophesy that every weapon of the enemy fashioned against you is destroyed right now. Every arrow of darkness fired at you is returned to sender right now.

Every evil plot against your life is scattered right now in the mighty name of Jesus. I come against every spirit of infirmity. I come against every spirit of sickness. I come against every spirit of disease. The Bible says in Exodus 15:26, "If thou will diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and will do that which is right in his sight, and will give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians.

For I am the Lord that health thee. I decree divine health over your body. I decree supernatural strength over your physical frame. I decree that every organ in your body will function according to divine design in the mighty name of Jesus. By the authority in the name of Jesus, I command every pain to leave your body now. Every headache go now. Every body ache go now. Every discomfort go now. Every strange feeling go now in the mighty name of Jesus.

I decree that the healing power of God is flowing through your body right now like a river from the crown of your head to the sole of your feet. Receive healing now in the mighty name of Jesus. Now I want us to pray concerning our families. The Bible says in Joshua 24:15, "And if it seem evil unto you to serve the Lord, choose you this day whom ye will serve, whether the gods which your father served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell.

But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord." Your family is not an accident. Your family is a divine institution. Your family is a covenant community. And the enemy knows that if he can destroy the family, he can destroy everything else. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for every family represented in this prayer session. Lord, I decree divine harmony. I decree supernatural unity. I decree uncommon love. I decree that every spirit of division will be cast out. Every spirit of strife will be bound.

Every spirit of confusion will be silenced in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy over your marriage. If you are married that your marriage will reflect the glory of God. Your marriage will be a testimony. Your marriage will be a model for others to follow. I decree that the love between you and your spouse will work stronger. The understanding between you and your spouse will grow deeper. The commitment between you and your spouse will become firmer in the mighty name of Jesus.

For those who are believing God for a life partner, I decree that God will bring the right person at the right time. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:22, "Who so findeth a wife findeth a good thing and obtained favor of the Lord, I decree that you will not settle for less than God's best. You will not be manipulated by pressure. You will not be deceived by counterfeits. You will know when God brings the right person and it will be a perfect fit in the mighty name of Jesus. I pray for your children.

I decree that your children will serve the Lord. Your children will walk in wisdom. Your children will fulfill their divine purpose. The Bible says in Isaiah 54:13, "And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of thy children." I prophesy that your children will be taught of the Lord. They will not be corrupted by the world. They will not be influenced by negative peer pressure. They will stand out. They will stand strong.

They will stand firm in their faith in the mighty name of Jesus. I come against every spirit of rebellion in the lives of your children. I bind every spirit of stubbornness. I cast out every spirit of wewardness. I decree that your children will be respectful. Your children will be obedient. Your children will honor you as their parent in the mighty name of Jesus. The Bible says in Proverbs 22:6, "Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he's old, he will not depart from it.

I decree that the training you are giving your children will not be in vain. The seeds you are sewing will produce a harvest. The investments you are making will yield dividends in the mighty name of Jesus. Now let us pray concerning our finances. I need you to understand that poverty is not humility. Poverty is not spirituality. Poverty is a curse.

The Bible says in Deuteronomy 28:12, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand, and thou shall lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow." God's plan for you is abundance. God's plan for you is prosperity. God's plan for you is overflow. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come against every spirit of poverty. I bind every spirit of lack. I cast out every spirit of insufficiency.

I decree that the windows of heaven are open over your life. I decree that blessings are being poured out upon you. I decree that you will not have room enough to contain it in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy that divine ideas are coming to you. Business concepts are being downloaded to you. Creative strategies are being revealed to you.

The Bible says in Deuteronomy 8:18, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which is swear unto thy fathers, as it is this day." I decree that God is giving you power to create wealth. God is giving you wisdom to manage resources. God is giving you understanding to multiply what is in your hand. In the mighty name of Jesus, I decree that your work will be blessed. Your business will be blessed.

Your investments will be blessed. Everything your hand touches will prosper in the mighty name of Jesus. The Bible says in Psalm 1:3, "And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water that bringeth forth his fruit in his season. His leaf also shall not wither and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper. I prophesy that you are like that tree. You are planted by the rivers of water. You are bringing forth fruit in your season. Your leaf is not withering.

Everything you do is prospering in the mighty name of Jesus. I come against every spirit of debt. I decree that you will owe no man anything but love. Romans 13:8 says, "Owe no man anything but to love one another. For he that loveth another had fulfilled the law. I prophesy financial freedom. I prophesy economic liberation. I prophesy that every debt will be paid. Every loan will be cleared. Every financial obligation will be met in the mighty name of Jesus." Now let us engage in spiritual warfare.

The Bible says in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." You need to understand that there is a battle in the realm of the spirit. There are forces that are working against you. There are entities that are opposing your destiny. But the good news is that greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.

Father, in the name of Jesus, I take authority over every principality assigned against the lives of your children. I bind them now. I cast them down now. I render them powerless now in the mighty name of Jesus. Every power in the second heaven manipulating circumstances against your favor, I command them to be paralyzed now. I command them to be dismantled now. I command them to be destroyed now in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that the angels of the Lord are encamped around you.

Psalm 34:7 says, "The angel of the Lord encamped round about them that fear him and deliverth them." I prophesy that divine protection is surrounding you. Angelic assistance is available to you. Heavenly reinforcement is coming to your aid in the mighty name of Jesus. Every altar speaking against your life, I command that altar to catch fire now. Every covenant working against your destiny, I break that covenant now by the blood of Jesus.

Every sacrifice offered to hinder your progress, I nullify that sacrifice now by the authority in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Isaiah 8:10, "Take counsel together and it shall come to not. Speak the word and it shall not stand for God is with us. I decree that every counsel of the enemy against you will come to nothing. Every word spoken against you will not stand in the mighty name of Jesus. I come against every spirit of delay. I come against every spirit of postponement.

I come against every spirit of frustration. The Bible says in Habachuk 2:3, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tar, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry. I decree that your appointed time has come. Your season has arrived. Your moment has manifested in the mighty name of Jesus. Every good thing that has been delayed in your life, I prophesy that it is released now. Every blessing that has been held back, it is released now.

Every promise that has been postponed, it is released now. In the mighty name of Jesus, I decree acceleration. I decree speed. I decree that things will begin to move fast for you from this moment forward in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, let us pray for spiritual growth. The Bible says in 2 Peter 3:18, "But grow in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever." Amen. You see spiritual maturity is not automatic. Spiritual growth is intentional.

You must desire it. You must pursue it. You must invest in it. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for spiritual hunger. I pray for divine thirst. I pray that your children will not be satisfied with shallow spirituality. Lord, let them hunger for more of you. Let them thirst for deeper intimacy. Let them pursue you with all their heart in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that the word of God will be precious to you.

The Bible says in Jeremiah 15:16, "Thy words were found and I did eat them and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart. For I am called by thy name, oh Lord God of hosts. I prophesy that you will find joy in studying the scriptures. You will find delight in meditating on the word. You will find pleasure in hiding God's word in your heart. In the mighty name of Jesus, I pray for consistency in your prayer life. I decree that prayer will not be a burden to you. Prayer will be a delight to you.

Prayer will be your first resort, not your last resort. The Bible says in 1 Thessalonians 5:17, "Pray without ceasing. I prophesy that you will become a person of prayer. You will develop an altar of intercession. You will build a history with God in the place of prayer in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that the Holy Spirit will be real to you. You will not just know about him. You will know him personally. You will recognize his voice. You will discern his leading.

You will obey his prompings in the mighty name of Jesus. The Bible says in John 16:13, "How be it, when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth, for he shall not speak of himself, but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak, and he will show you things to come." I prophesy that the Holy Spirit will guide you into all truth. He will show you things to come. He will prepare you for what is ahead in the mighty name of Jesus. Let us pray for divine favor.

The Bible says in Psalm 5:12, "For thou Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield." Favor is not just being liked by people. Favor is the supernatural advantage that makes you stand out. Favor is the divine endorsement that causes you to succeed where others fail. Favor is the heavenly backing that opens doors that were locked. Father, in the name of Jesus, I decree uncommon favor upon every life under the sound of my voice.

I decree that you will find favor with God and with men. Luke 2:52 says that Jesus is increased in wisdom and stature and in favor with God and man. I prophesy that you will increase in favor. You will grow in favor. You will multiply in favor in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that when you walk into a room, favor will announce you. When you submit an application, favor will recommend you. When you are being considered for an opportunity, favor will select you in the mighty name of Jesus.

You will not struggle for what God has ordained for you. You will not beg for what belongs to you by divine right. You will not compete for your God-given portion in the mighty name of Jesus. I come against every spirit of disfavor. I bind every force working to make you unacceptable. I cast down every power trying to make you rejected.

The Bible says in Isaiah 60:10, "And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee, for in my wroth I smoke thee, but in my favor have I had mercy on thee. I prophesy that in this season, God's favor is upon you. People who were indifferent to you will suddenly become interested in you. Those who overlooked you will begin to seek you out. doors that were closed to you will swing wide open in the mighty name of Jesus. Now let us pray concerning divine wisdom.

The Bible says in James 1:5, "If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God that giveth to all men liberally and operate not and it shall be given him." Wisdom is more valuable than wealth. Wisdom is more precious than position. Proverbs 4-7 says, "Wisdom is the principal thing." Therefore, get wisdom and with all thy getting, get understanding. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for the spirit of wisdom, I ask that you will grant your children divine insight. Give them supernatural understanding.

Give them heavenly intelligence. In the mighty name of Jesus, I decree that you will not make foolish decisions. You will not walk into traps. You will not fall into pits. The wisdom of God will keep you. The understanding of God will preserve you. The knowledge of God will protect you in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy that you will know what to do in every situation. You will know what to say in every circumstance. You will know how to respond in every challenge.

The Bible says in Proverbs 2:6, "For the Lord giveth wisdom. Out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding." I decree that God is giving you wisdom. Out of his mouth is coming knowledge and understanding for you in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that you will make wise investments. You will make profitable decisions. You will make sound judgments. Every choice you make will be guided by divine wisdom. Every step you take will be ordered by heavenly understanding in the mighty name of Jesus.

Let us pray for your purpose and destiny. The Bible says in Jeremiah 29-11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end." God has a plan for your life. God has a purpose for your existence. God has a destiny that he designed specifically for you. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray that your children will discover their purpose. I pray that they will walk in their calling.

I pray that they will fulfill their destiny in the mighty name of Jesus. I come against every spirit of confusion concerning purpose. I bind every force trying to derail destiny. I cast out every influence trying to distract from divine assignment. In the mighty name of Jesus, I decree that you will not waste your life. You will not live aimlessly. You will not drift purposelessly.

The Bible says in Ephesians 2:10, "For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them." I prophesy that you will walk in the good works that God prepared for you before the foundation of the world. You will fulfill what God created you to accomplish. You will complete what God commissioned you to do in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that everything you need to fulfill your purpose is available to you.

Every resource, every connection, every opportunity, every skill, every talent, everything is available in the mighty name of Jesus. God will not call you to do something without equipping you to do it. God will not send you somewhere without providing for you to get there. God will not assign you a task without anointing you to complete it in the mighty name of Jesus.

Now, beloved, as we begin to come to the close of this prayer session, I want you to understand that prayer is not just what we do in moments like this. Prayer must become a lifestyle. Prayer must become your default mode. Prayer must become your habitual response to everything in life. The Bible says in Philippians 4:6, "Be careful for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known unto God. I decree that you will become a person who prays about everything.

You will not worry about anything. You will not be anxious about anything. You will pray about everything in the mighty name of Jesus. I prophesy that this morning's prayer has activated things in the realm of the spirit. Angels have been dispatched. Heavenly decrees have been issued. Divine verdicts have been pronounced. What we have prayed is not falling to the ground. What we have declared is not returning void. The Bible says in Isaiah 55-11, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth.

It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it. I decree that the word we have spoken this morning will accomplish what it was sent to accomplish. It will prosper in the thing for which it was sent. You will see the manifestation of what we have prayed. You will experience the reality of what we have declared. You will testify of the power of what we have released in the mighty name of Jesus.

Father, I thank you for this time of prayer. I thank you for the privilege of standing in the gap. I thank you for the authority you have given us in the name of Jesus. Lord, I seal everything we have prayed with the blood of Jesus. Let it be established. Let it be confirmed. Let it be manifested in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that this day will be different. This week will be different. This month will be different. This year will be different. Things are changing for you from this moment forward.

The Bible says in Isaiah 43:19, "Behold, I will do a new thing now. It shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." I prophesy that God is doing a new thing in your life. It is springing forth now. You will know it. You will see it. You will experience it in the mighty name of Jesus. Every agreement we have made with God in prayer this morning, I decree that it is sealed in heaven.

Every covenant we have entered into with the Lord, it is ratified in the court of heaven. Every declaration we have made in faith, it is recorded in the books of eternity. In the mighty name of Jesus, I speak peace over your spirit. I speak rest over your soul. I speak strength over your body. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace in the mighty name of Jesus. Go forth with confidence.

Go forth with boldness. Go forth with assurance. You are covered by the blood. You are protected by angels. You are guided by the Holy Spirit. You are favored by God. You are destined for greatness. You are ordained for significance. You are called to make a difference in the mighty name of Jesus. In Jesus's mighty name we have prayed.
